title: Spotted Garden Eel Adventure
description:
StoryGoh, the main character who can't swim despite being a dingo, was rejected by a girl on a matching app and made fun of by his friends, so he finally decided to take a leap of faith and set out on a journey to learn how to swim.GenreIt's an orthodox action game with nothing out of the ordinary.
Collect coins and EXP to purchase weapons and unlock skills to enhance the main character!StageStages is a very common platformer game.
Money is obtained by destroying boxes containing items.
Defeating enemies will drop exp.
These can be used in the briefing scenes that are interspersed between stages.Story partAdventure-style skits are interspersed between stages.Boss BattleSome stages have a boss at the end.
Clear the stage by eliminating the boss's HP.Briefing SceneDuring the briefing scene, money and exp gained during the stage can be used to purchase weapons and unlock skills to enhance the player.
Weapons include shotguns, homing and piercing bullets, and many others.
Unlocking skills will increase the player's actions, such as being able to jump two bullets, increase HP, etc.
description_short: Goh, the main character who can't swim even though he is a dingo, was rejected by a girl on a matching app, and his friends made fun of him, so he finally decided to set out on a journey to learn to swim. It's a simple, orthodox action game.
